name: Advanced Parry
effect: When parrying multiple hits, distribute DoS among any amount of attackers. Still requires more DoS than the opponent for single hits. Can also parry Flexible weapons.

name: Alpha Strike
prerequisites: From the shadows, no Beta Strike
effect: Successfully attacking an unaware target automatically hits critically.

name: Assassin Strike
effect: Scoring a critical hit or deathblow in melee allows the character to move up to his speed in meters right away without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Augsmith
effect: The character is capable of repairing cybernetic implants.

name: Bar Fighter
effect: Ignore \emph{Improvised} penalties.

name: Battle Mind
effect: The character may add a tenth of his Intelligence to \emph{Base Initiative}.

name: Battle Sense
effect: Adds a fifth of Perception Bonus (2, 4, or 8) to initiative. Doubles penalties to attacks of opportunity against the character.

name: Beta Strike
effect: The user gains +10 to hit any character that has already attacked him during this combat encounter.

name: Blind Fighting
effect: Limits the penalties for being blinded in melee combat to -10.

name: Blurry
effect: While sprinting the character imposes a -20 to everyone trying to hit him.

name: Broken
effect: Grants +30 to fear and pinning tests but doubles penalties from bad reputation or disposition.

name: Butcher
effect: Damage dealt with blades is increased by 1 for one-handed weapons and 2 for two-handed weapons.

name: Calculated Pilot
effect: Halves penalties for piloting tests in demanding, stressful situations.

name: Calming Focus
effect: Re-roll one failed fear or pinning test per turn.

name: Calming Presence
effect: The character may take an action to make a command test at a +20 bonus. For every degree of success all allies he addresses gain a +10 to tests to resist fear and pinning.

name: Clear Target
effect: Halves penalties for calling hit locations on ranged attacks.

name: Clotter
effect: When starting to bleed, make a toughness check at a -10 penalty. On a success the character doesn't bleed.

name: Companion
effect: The character may adopt a small companion. The GM will explain the details.

name: Crack Shot
effect: Before taking a shot, make a perception check at a penalty equal to twice the target location armor. On a success halve the armor for this attack. Has no effect on shields.

name: Dominion
effect: When taking a Defensive Stance and not moving, the control area is increased to 360°. The character may also gain attacks of opportunity against disengaging enemies.

name: Drunken Master
effect: Limits the penalty to melee combat resulting from intoxication to -10. While intoxicated he himself is at a -20 to hit and can use maneuvers as normal.\\ Costs half as much for \textit{balanced} characters.

name: Dual Wielding
effect: Halves penalties for dual wielding. Has to be taken once for melee and once for ranged separately.

name: Earth Shaker
effect: Damage dealt with blunt weapons is increased by 1 for one-handed weapons or 2 for two-handed weapons.

name: Executioner
effect: Grants +10 to hit bleeding targets.

name: Expert Wrestler
effect: The character is incredibly well-trained in grappling that he can initiate a Hold as a free action.

name: Face Breaker
effect: Grants unarmed strikes the Trauma special rule.

name: Fighting Retreat
effect: Allows a single attack to be made when disengaging. This attack counts as being performed in movement.

name: Flip Up
effect: When standing up, reduce the time it takes by an action: prone to standing now takes one action or a free action and a successful agility test.

name: Focused Frenzy
effect: When the character is made to go berserk by some means, they can still identify friend and foe. When no foes are left and the \emph{Frenzy} does not end, friends still become valid targets.

name: Formation
effect: When taking Combined Actions, everyone involved is granted a +10, up to +30 when three or more characters have Formation. When \emph{Unbreakable Bond} partners also have Formation, those two gain an additional +10.

name: From The Shadows
effect: During the first round of combat the character has 6 additional initiative, unless the character was ambushed or similarly caught off guard.

name: Gruesome
effect: When destroying body locations or landing a killing blow, the character makes an Intimidate test with a bonus equal to twice the last attack's damage. All fear tests suffer an additional penalty equal to 10 + 5 per DoS.

name: Hand-To-Hand Basics
effect: When fighting armed enemies, the character counts as armed as well.

name: Hax0r e1337
effect: Add two degrees of success to any Wirewalk tests to crack other devices or protect your own.

name: Heroic
effect: Grants +15 to fear and pinning tests.

name: High Noon
effect: When drawing a pistol, the character may take a single shot as a free action.

name: Iron Fist
effect: Every unarmed strike may now count as a having Stun(0) without inferring a penalty.

name: Lead Storm
effect: Weapons with a fire rate of more than 1 which are not launchers always count as braced.

name: Light Sleeper
effect: Overly Cautious now also works when sleeping or intoxicated.

name: Marksman
effect: Halves penalties for long ranges.

name: Medical Insight
effect: Doubles the degrees of success on Bio-Maintenance tests to help others recover.

name: Mighty Companion
effect: The character may adopt a powerful companion. The GM will explain the details.

name: Mobile Combat
effect: Halves penalties for fighting while moving. This includes a Charge maneuver's flat penalty if the character also has Maneuver: Charge.

name: Natural Geek
effect: The character can add their Education's full bonus, regardless of it surpassing the Skill's bonus.

name: On Your Feet!
effect: The character may take an action to make a command check. On a success an ally gains a +5 per degree of success to any action following the character's orders.

name: One-Man Artillery
effect: Launchers always count as being braced.

name: Overly Cautious
effect: The character becomes jittery or nervous, but when attacked he can ignore Unaware conditions by passing a Routine Perception check, so long as he is not asleep, intoxicated or otherwise impaired.

name: Peer
effect: Gain +15 to interaction tests with a specified group of people. May be chosen once per group of people.

name: Perfectionist Craftsman
effect: Doubles the degrees of success on crafting tests when the specific skill is used.\\ May (theoretically) be taken once per skill.

name: Personified Inspiration
effect: When the character does a daring or heroic deed, all allies present are immune to fear and pinning for the rest of the encounter or scene.

name: Precision Strike
effect: Halves penalties for attacking small targets with melee attacks.

name: Protective Stance
effect: When taking a Defensive Stance, the character may turn active actions into reactions without penalties and he may parry for allies within his melee range.

name: Provoke
effect: Spend an action to taunt an enemy and make a fitting skill test opposed by the target's \emph{Restraint}. If the character wins, the target must attack the character at the next opportunity.

name: Quick Draw
effect: Draw smaller equipment pieces, pistols and one-handed melee weapons as a free action.

name: Rapid Reload
effect: When reducing reload time to below 1 action, reload as a free action.

name: Reliable Reputation
effect: Halves penalties from bad disposition.

name: Render
effect: When dealing damage with the Tearing rule, roll an additional dice. Still only keep one.

name: Revenge
effect: When taking damage from a direct attack, you may forego one of your actions later in the combat round to immediately attack the offending enemy.

name: Ripper
effect: When dealing damage with the Tearing rule and rolling doubles, you may choose those two dice (instead of keeping just one).

name: Sidearm
effect: When attacking in melee combat with a melee weapon in one hand and a pistol in the other, the character takes no penalties from shooting in melee combat.

name: Skinner
effect: Before taking a melee attack, make a perception check at a penalty equal to twice the target location armor. On a success halve the armor for this attack.

name: Skull Taker
effect: Removes penalties from calling hit locations for ranged attacks (when combined with Clear Target) or melee attacks (when combined with Precision Strike).

name: Snapshot
effect: Aiming takes half as long.

name: Stabilization
effect: The character is able to staunch light bleeding on others in one round without equipment.

name: Steadfast
effect: Tests to prevent falling over are at a +10.

name: Steady Aim
effect: When aiming, line of sight may be broken for a round without aiming being interrupted. By GM discretion this may count even longer if the target is moving particularly predictably.

name: Strong Back
effect: The character's carry weight is increased by half.

name: Supreme Awareness
effect: Roll twice when determining initiative or gathering senses, picking the higher result.

name: Tactical Advance
effect: While advancing carefully from one cover to the next over a distance of MS meters in one turn, the character counts as in cover for the whole way.

name: The Best Defense
effect: Reduces offensive penalties of Defensive Stance by 20.

name: Thick Skull
effect: Grants immunity to the Trauma special rule and resisting the \emph{Stun} special rule gains +10.

name: Threatening Presence
effect: Impose a -15 penalty to enemies' tests against fear and intimidation.

name: Too Angry To Die
effect: While frenzied, the character has to take at least 8 damage at once or lose his head in order to die. Bleeding out only starts when the character stops frenzying, but he will in this case be unconscious when frenzy ends.

name: Trained Sense
effect: Grants a +10 bonus to sensory checks using that sense. Can be taken once for every sense.

name: Unbreakable Bond
prerequisites: being good friends; if one is Clumsy and the other is Cursed by Fortuna, the cost is only 100 XP
effect: When around one particular close friend, that friend may make a +20 charisma check as a free action and every degree of success gives the character +10 to resist fear and pinning, as well as potentially the effects of disabling characteristics. If both of them have Unbreakable Bond, the bonus to the charisma check is +40 instead.

name: Unquestioned
effect: Penalties to Command tests resulting from disbelief in authority (e.g. represented by Rebel or some Bound by Principle) do not apply.

name: Unrestrained Reflexes
effect: The character may make an additional dodge action using the same reaction. This may happen once per turn.

name: Vault
effect: The character can use suitable objects in the environment to double jump height and leap length during movement without slowing down.

name: Volume of Fire
effect: When using a weapon with a rate of fire above 1 to take a standard shot, the character may spend more ammunition to gain a +5 to hit per shot fired after the first, up to the weapon's rate of fire.

name: Walk It Off
effect: The character can continue acting while bleeding until completely bled out. If combined with Tough as nails, the character may enter a frenzy when bleeding as well.

name: Where It Hurts
effect: The character's unarmed attacks may gain the Tearing special rule.
